rationale: The agent correctly verified the user via email, retrieved the user’s orders, confirmed both were delivered (eligible for return), and successfully submitted return requests for all items on both orders. The final information provided (returns submitted, refunds to original payment methods, email instructions forthcoming) was consistent with tool outputs. However, the agent initiated the return actions without first explicitly restating the items to be returned and obtaining the user’s confirmation prior to making order-changing writes. Policy requires explicit confirmation before any order-changing action, so despite otherwise correct handling, this is a fail.
